title: The Core Premise: Signals as Carriers
t: The Core Premise: Signals as Carriers
description: HIS SIGNATURE CONCEPT (speculative — not medical fact): the foundational idea of this database — that wireless signals, which already carry information everywhere, might one day be designed to carry health-RELEVANT interactions: sensing, timing, coordination.
